shots.speaker: MO
shots.action: Mo pointing at Karl's forehead 48.000.000 €, screaming

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.action: Karl putting a finger on his lips, a customer in the background

shots.speaker: MO
shots.action: Mo outraged

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.text: Ich hab dein Geld versteckt. Bevor du irgendwas unterschreibst.
shots.action: Karl calm, holding the contract folder

shots.speaker: MO
shots.text: Und was hab ich dann unterschrieben?
shots.action: Mo confused

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.text: Ein leeres Konto. Und ein Hamster-Abo.
shots.action: Karl deadpan

shots.speaker: MO
shots.action: Mo bursting out laughing

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.text: Für Jessy. Sie wollte doch einen.
shots.action: Karl with a tiny smirk

shots.speaker: MO
shots.action: Mo looking at Karl in awe

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.action: Karl deadpan

shots.speaker: MO
shots.text: Aber die zwei sind noch frei. Mit meiner Yacht!
shots.action: Mo pointing at the TV showing the yacht
shots.motion: he points angrily at the TV

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.action: Karl taking off his apron

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.text: Kleb dir das auf die Stirn.
shots.action: Karl handing Mo a glowing LED sticker showing 500.000.000 €
shots.motion: he peels off the sticker backing

shots.speaker: MO
shots.text: Fünfhundert Millionen?! Das ist ein Aufkleber!
shots.action: Mo with the sticker on his forehead showing 500.000.000 €, slightly crooked

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.action: Karl deadpan

shots.speaker: MO
shots.text: Leute! Ich hab nochmal gewonnen! Fünfhundert Millionen!
shots.action: Mo filming himself live in front of the kiosk, pointing at his forehead 500.000.000 €
shots.motion: he films himself and points at the sticker

shots.speaker: JESSY
shots.action: Jessy staring at her phone showing Mo's live video, the banker at the wheel
shots.motion: she screams at the banker, he spins the wheel

shots.speaker: JESSY
shots.text: Mo, Schatz! Ich hab dich so vermisst!
shots.action: Jessy running toward Mo in the rain in front of the kiosk
shots.motion: she runs in slow motion with open arms

shots.speaker: MO
shots.action: Mo with crossed arms

shots.speaker: JESSY
shots.action: Jessy smiling innocently

shots.speaker: LILA
shots.text: Herr Mo! Ein neuer Vertrag. Mit noch besseren Konditionen.
shots.action: the banker arriving with a new contract and the gold pen

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.text: Darf ich? Seite zwei: „Alles gehört Doktor Lila.“ Seite drei: „Wirklich alles.“
shots.action: Karl reading the contract aloud, the banker sweating

shots.speaker: LILA
shots.action: the banker sweating, forced smile

shots.speaker: ZITRONE
shots.text: Polizei. Doktor Lila, Sie sind festgenommen. Wegen Betrug.
shots.action: the lemon police officer stepping out of a police car with blue lights
shots.motion: she flashes her badge, blue lights flash

shots.speaker: LILA
shots.action: the banker outraged

shots.speaker: ZITRONE
shots.camera: close-up on the banker's forehead display flickering from 980.000 € to -3.200.000 €
shots.action: the lemon officer pointing at the banker's forehead
shots.motion: his display glitches and drops to -3.200.000 €

shots.speaker: JESSY
shots.text: Minus drei Millionen?! Du hast gesagt, du bist reich!
shots.action: Jessy hitting the banker with her handbag
shots.motion: she swings her handbag at him

shots.speaker: LILA
shots.text: Ich hab gesagt, ich wirke reich.
shots.action: the banker in handcuffs

shots.speaker: ZITRONE
shots.action: the officer putting handcuffs on Jessy

shots.speaker: JESSY
shots.action: Jessy being led to the police car

shots.speaker: MO
shots.action: Mo waving goodbye with a smirk, peeling off the sticker
shots.motion: he waves and peels off the sticker

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.text: Hier. Achtundvierzig Millionen. Zurück auf deine Stirn.
shots.action: Karl tapping his phone, the 48.000.000 € flying from his forehead back to Mo's forehead
shots.motion: the numbers fly from Karl's forehead to Mo's

shots.speaker: MO
shots.text: Warum hast du das Geld nicht einfach behalten?
shots.action: Mo looking at Karl, emotional

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.action: Karl calm

shots.speaker: MO
shots.action: Mo honest and awkward

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.action: Karl with a small smile

shots.speaker: KALLE
shots.text: Mo, mein Junge! Dein Lieblingsonkel ist wieder da!
shots.action: the coconut uncle bursting through the kiosk door
shots.motion: he bursts in with open arms

shots.speaker: KARL
shots.action: Mo and Karl turning to the uncle at the same time
shots.motion: both turn their heads in sync
